findings.title: Indexed prediction-market policy lets the creator resolve and drain before expiry
findings.description: The index presents its linked policies as complete, deployable examples and recommends the prediction-market policy. In bounded-onchain/docs/examples/prediction-market-amm.md, the pmResolves create rule checks creator identity and outcome but never requires @time.now >= expiryTs, despite the page claiming resolution is accepted only after expiry. The creator can open a far-future market, wait for a victim to buy YES, immediately resolve NO, which sets winningSupply to zero, and then satisfy the creator-withdrawal rule immediately to sweep the entire collateral reserve. The policy E2E specification reinforces the flaw by creating a market expiring in 2099 and expecting immediate resolution to succeed.
findings.recommendation: Add @time.now >= get(/pmMarkets/$marketId).expiryTs and an upper resolution deadline to the pmResolves create rule. Add an E2E denial test for pre-expiry resolution and retain a post-expiry success test before continuing to list the policy as deployable.
